notes: Hotfix for 0.16.0/0.16.1: a startup crash killed the Orb gesture layer, so Reach (and Settings behind it) never opened. The crash is fixed and verified in a test harness before release: the app boots clean, Reach opens, Settings opens. Everything else from 0.16.0 stands — up opens the drawer, AI stays parked, the fan stays in thumb reach, and Reach keeps its open/close animation.
